questions.question_english: A recognized private unaided school fails to pay its teachers the salaries stipulated under Section 10 of the DSEA 1973 for six consecutive months. The teachers file a complaint. What immediate administrative action can the Director of Education take?
options_english: The Director can suspend the managing committee and appoint an Administrator.
The Director can disburse salaries from treasury and recover them from future school taxes.
The Director possesses no statutory enforcement authority because it is an unaided school.
The Director can only formally request the PTA to raise voluntary funds for the teachers.
questions.explanation_english: The Director can suspend the managing committee and appoint an Administrator. Under Section 10 and Section 20 of the Delhi School Education Act, 1973, failure to disburse mandated employee salaries for extended periods constitutes severe administrative neglect. The Director of Education can recommend suspending the managing committee and appointing an Authorized Officer to take over school administration, restore salary disbursements, and enforce compliance.

I. वह कार्यालय प्रमुख के रूप में कार्य करता है।
II. वह विद्यालय के वित्तीय प्रशासन के लिए उत्तरदायी होता है।
III. वह प्रबंध समिति से परामर्श किए बिना PGT शिक्षकों की नियुक्ति कर सकता है।
कौन-से कथन सही हैं?

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements about the 'Head of the School' under DSER 1973:
I. He/She functions as the Head of the Office.
II. He/She is responsible for the financial administration of the school.
III. He/She can appoint PGT teachers without consulting the Managing Committee. Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements I and II are correct. The Head of School functions as the head of the office and has responsibilities connected with the school's financial administration, records and day-to-day management. These responsibilities do not amount to an unrestricted power to appoint PGT teachers independently of the prescribed selection process and Managing Committee or other competent authority. Recruitment must follow qualifications, selection rules and required approvals.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन I और II सही हैं। विद्यालय प्रमुख प्रशासनिक तथा वित्तीय कार्यों में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है, जिसमें कार्यालय संचालन, अभिलेख और वित्तीय नियंत्रण शामिल हो सकते हैं। लेकिन इस भूमिका से उसे नियुक्ति-प्रक्रिया और प्रबंध समिति के वैधानिक अधिकारों को दरकिनार करने की असीमित शक्ति नहीं मिलती। PGT शिक्षक की नियुक्ति निर्धारित योग्यता, चयन-प्रक्रिया और आवश्यक समिति/प्राधिकारी की भागीदारी के अधीन होती है।

questions.question_english: Under DSEA 1973, which authority can exempt any recognized school from the operation of any of the provisions of the Rules, in the interest of education?
questions.explanation_english: The Administrator Under Section 28 and related statutory provisions of the Delhi School Education Act, 1973, the Administrator of the Union territory of Delhi holds executive authority to grant exemptions to recognized schools from specific operational rules, provided such exemptions serve educational interests, promote innovation, or alleviate structural hardships.

questions.question_english: Who among the following is defined as the "Director" under the Delhi School Education Act, 1973?
options_english: The Secretary of the Ministry of Education
The Principal of the District Institute of Education and Training
questions.explanation_english: The Director of Education, Delhi Section 2(h) of the Delhi School Education Act, 1973 defines "Director" as the Director of Education, Delhi, and includes any other officer authorized by the Administrator to perform the functions of the Director. As the administrative head of the Directorate of Education, the Director exercises statutory supervision, inspection powers, fee regulation, and enforcement of education rules.

questions.question_english: Rule 14 of DSER 1973 deals with which of the following aspects of school administration?
options_english: Code of Conduct for Teachers and Staff
questions.explanation_english: Issue of Transfer Certificate Rule 14 of the Delhi School Education Rules, 1973 specifically governs the administrative procedure for issuing Transfer Certificates (TC) to students. It prescribes timelines for processing applications, conditions for withholding TCs due to unpaid dues, and counter-signature procedures required when students transfer between recognized educational institutions.
